description_en: Queries the traffic monitoring data of accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRealTimeTrafficData查询加速域名的流量监控数据
name: DescribeDomainRealTimeTrafficData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 100 domain names in a single query
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持100个域名查询
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the data to retrieve.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the ISP.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query ISPs. If you do not specify this parameter, all ISPs are queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获取。不传该参数默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query regions. If you do not specify this parameter, all regions are queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获取。不传该参数默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to retrieve.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en:
The time interval between each record, in seconds.

This parameter returns a fixed value of 60 (1 minute), 300 (5 minutes), or 3600 (1 hour) based on the maximum time span of a single query. For more information, see the time granularity in the usage notes
DataInterval.description_zh:
每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数固定返回60（1分钟）、300（5分钟）或3600（1小时），具体请参见使用说明中返回数据时间粒度

DomainName.description_en: The information about the accelerated domain names

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard and in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 结束时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

DataModule.description_en: The traffic data for each time interval, in bytes
DataModule.description_zh: 每个时间间隔的流量数据，单位：Byte

items.description_en: The traffic data for each time interval
items.description_zh: 每个时间间隔的流量数据

TimeStamp.description_en: The start time of the time slice. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard and in UTC
TimeStamp.description_zh: 时间片起始时刻。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

StartTime.description_en: The start time. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard and in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 开始时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间
